$comment: Transcribed from Invoca's design-token naming specification (Google Sheets). This is a COMMITTED SNAPSHOT, not a live dependency: it is diffable and gated by emit-tokens.mjs --check. The spec is the baseline the design language is being built on; where it and Titan source disagree, see TITAN-DIV-09. Owner-confirmed as the vocabulary of record.

grammar.note: A token name is composed from these axes in this order. Not every axis applies to every token; omitted axes collapse.

definitions.text-secondary: Text color to provide supplementary information
definitions.text-success: Use for positive outcome, such as success messaging
definitions.text-info: Use for informative text, such as in progress
definitions.text-error: Use for critical text, such as an error
definitions.text-warning: Use for warning or caution text
definitions.text-success-alt: Alternative text color for positive outcomes
definitions.text-info-alt: Alternative text color for informative outcomes
definitions.text-neutral-alt: Alternative text color for neutral outcomes
definitions.text-warning-alt: Alternative text color for warning or cautious outcomes
definitions.text-error-alt: Alternative text color for critical outcomes
definitions.link-default: Text color for any text navigating the user to another web page
definitions.icon-success: Use for positive outcomes where an icon supplements the text
definitions.icon-info: Use for informative outcomes where an icon supplements the text
definitions.icon-error: Use for negative outcomes where an icon supplements the text
definitions.icon-warning: Use for warnings where an icon supplements the text
definitions.icon-success-alt: Alternative icon color for positive outcomes
definitions.icon-info-alt: Alternative icon color for informative outcomes
definitions.icon-neutral-alt: Alternative icon color for neutral outcomes
definitions.icon-warning-alt: Alternative icon color for warning or cautious outcomes
definitions.icon-error-alt: Alternative icon color for critical outcomes
definitions.border-warning: Border color for warning or caution outcomes
definitions.border-focus: Border color for focused elements when using keyboard navigation
definitions.background-default: Background for containers and elements 1 level above the view
definitions.background-warning: Background for warning or caution outcomes
definitions.background-warning-alt: Alternative background for warning or cautious outcomes
definitions.background-disabled: Default background for any disabled element
definitions.view-overlay-default: Default background for any component that uses an overlay
definitions.text-positive: Use for positive outcomes such as success messages
definitions.text-neutral: Alternative text color for neutral outcomes
definitions.text-negative: Use for critical text, such as an error
definitions.text-positive-alt: Alternative text color for positive outcomes such as success messages
definitions.text-negative-alt: Alternative text color for negative outcomes such as error messages
definitions.icon-positive: Use for positive outcomes where an icon supplements the text such as success messages
definitions.icon-neutral: Use for neutral outcomes where an icon supplements the text
definitions.icon-negative: Use for negative outcomes where an icon supplements the text
definitions.icon-positive-alt: Alternative icon color for positive outcomes
definitions.icon-negative-alt: Alternative icon color for critical outcomes
definitions.border-positive: Border color for positive outcomes such as success messages, true values, live statuses, etc.
definitions.border-negative: Border color for negative outcomes such as error messages, destructive actions, permanent impacts, etc.
definitions.background-positive: Background for positive outcomes such as success messages, true values, live statuses, etc.
definitions.background-negative: Background for negative outcomes such as error messages, destructive actions, permanent impacts, etc.
definitions.background-positive-alt: Alternative background for positive outcomes such as success messages, true values, live statuses, etc.
definitions.background-negative-alt: Alternative background for negative outcomes such as error messages, destructive actions, permanent impacts, etc.
